bug_semantics: When Renovate updates Gradle Wrapper artifacts it reads distributionUrl from gradle-wrapper.properties and concatenates it unquoted into a command string (./gradlew :wrapper --gradle-distribution-url <value>) that is executed through a shell. A malicious distributionUrl containing $(...) or other shell metacharacters is evaluated by /bin/sh before Gradle parses the URL, so an attacker who can land that file in a scanned repo gets arbitrary command execution in the Renovate runtime even with allowScripts off.
flaw_origin: PR #6003 member 969f2c5f (2020-04-19, Rhys Arkins) first added getDistributionUrl() and cmd += ` --gradle-distribution-url ${distributionUrl}` in lib/manager/gradle-wrapper/artifacts.ts. Parent 5145c044 only interpolated config.toVersion as --gradle-version. That command already went through child_process.exec (always a shell); 32.124.0 (892595aea) later switched to spawn but forced shell:true, preserving the same evaluation. 42.68.5 f430552de stopped using shell by default, which is the advisory patch.
